It's a monster sports night, also with Monday Night Football, WNBA Finals, and NHL games.

Celtics get the 2-for-1 to end the first frame. Jayson Tatum got to the line, where he went 2/2, then got to the basket for a layup. 

Tatum has 8 points, 5 assists, and 1 steal. The Celtics lead the Bulls 33-21 entering the second quarter.
